about.title: About us
about.mission: UyService is a home repair service across Uzbekistan. Leaking tap, dead socket or an air conditioner that won't cool — open the app, pick the problem and we'll find the top-rated handyman nearest to you. You watch them arrive on the map, just like a taxi.
about.step1Text: Choose one of 6 service types and the problem, add a photo if you like.
about.step2Text: Free handymen nearby are ranked by distance, rating and activity, and the best match gets the offer.
about.step3Text: Once accepted, you see where they are and how many minutes away.
about.step4Text: The price is agreed once the handyman sees the problem. Pay in cash after the work. Rate them.
about.p1Text: Calling a handyman costs {{fee}}, the same for every service. No hidden charges.
about.p2Text: If the problem comes back, the handyman returns for free.
about.p3Text: Every handyman has a rating and customer reviews. Those with verified documents are marked.
about.p4Text: No prepayment — you pay only once the work is done.
about.mastersText: Get jobs close to home. Choose your plan: monthly subscription or commission.
about.areaValue: All of Uzbekistan — wherever you are
